skills.description: 本技能从精细化的多个维度出发，评估、刻画或量化一个人的能力与潜在天赋，而不是只给一个单一分数。四大支柱使其可信且独具特色：
skills.description_zh: This skill evaluates, profiles, or quantifies a person's capabilities or latent potential across fine-grained dimensions instead of a single score. Four pillars make it credible and distinctive: (1) framework-informed dimensions anchored on Gardner's Multiple Intelligences, Big Five, and CHC theory — with 0–5 example anchors, but explicitly NOT clinically validated; (2) longitudinal re-verification via before/after radar deltas for the same subject over time; (3) a potential lens that surfaces people with no stage/track record yet; (4) evidence-traceable, never a single composite score or ranking. Lead mode discovers latent potential; a secondary mode quantifies demonstrated ability. It searches the latest frameworks, keeps the human in charge of standards, and targets "能者有条件多劳".
skills.name: 天赋潜力雷达

skills.description_zh: 过滤无效输出，维护会话日志，重置后自动恢复进度。适用于会话变长、上下文接近上限、需要跨会话延续工作，或需要压缩冗余输出降低 Token 消耗时使用。触发词 / Triggers: context-mode, 上下文管理, context management, session memory, token optimization.
skills.name: context-mode

skills.description: 根据用户提供的参考图片（或图片风格描述）和户外主题，为小红书与知乎两个平台分别生成完整的图文内容矩阵。小红书板块产出情绪种草文案（爆款标题、痛点共鸣正文、实操清单、互动引导、流量标签）加3张3:4竖版AI绘图提示词；知乎板块产出硬核攻略文案（问题式标题、断言开头、分章节数据支撑正文、专业图注）加2张16:9横版AI绘图提示词。当用户提到户外旅行、露营、徒步、登山、探险等户外主题，并希望生成小红书或知乎图文内容、配图提示词、社交媒体文案时触发。仅输出文案和AI绘图提示词，不直接生成图片。
